description: Breaking wave impact on a vertical pile D = 0.7 m in the GWK (Irschik et al. 2002): 5th-order Stokes waves H = 1.3 m, T = 4 s on d = 3.8 m, 1:10 slope, the wave breaks at the pile (tutorial 11_15, half domain with a symmetry plane, force x 2). Release level only: the slamming force (peak and rms over the measured impact) against the measured force; the lag is fitted on the force itself because the position of the measured gauge in the tutorial data is not documented.

reference.citation: Irschik, K., Sparboom, U. & Oumeraci, H. (2002) Breaking wave characteristics for the loading of a slender pile. Proc. 28th ICCE; GWK Hannover; measured data from the REEF3D tutorial 11_15 (Kamath et al. 2016, Ocean Engineering)
